scientific_integrity: Universal results are established by symbolic Gaussian moment identities, spectral inequalities, and phase averaging. Standalone finite exact tests corroborate but are not an exhaustive proof. Originality is best-knowledge, subject to further bibliographic examination.
scientific_limitations: Exact degree-two spherical harmonics on the unit S^3 only. The lower sixth moment is for real-valued harmonics only; complex lower endpoints, other degrees and dimensions are not determined. A previously proved fourth-moment eigenvalue bound is reused, not claimed as new. Bibliographic equivalences in unindexed invariant-theory literature remain possible.
title: Sharp sixth-moment endpoints and phase rigidity for quadratic harmonics on the three-sphere
